verdict.rationale: VirtualPostMail explicitly documents that a standard virtual mailbox is insufficient for bank account opening and that TruLease/TruResidence provide the physical-presence documentation (lease, utility bill) needed for such compliance, directly addressing where the address 'works and doesn't' (docs-33, docs-14, docs-31, docs-7). Missing for 10: explicit mention of payment processors specifically, and independent/third-party confirmation that banks actually accept this documentation in practice.
